ImageDescription.value: This photo was taken during a hike in a less touristy part of Karijini National Park. For days we were alone in this vast beautiful landscape. We heard a dingo pack howling in the middle of the night not far from our tents. We saw a 2m mulga attracted to the frogs in the water hole we drank from. We're puzzled by the glitters on the ground, which turned out to be our headlight reflected off the eyes of wolf spiders.
